build_curope_cuda_extension: build the curope CUDA extension module from curope.cpp and kernels.cu sources using torch cpp extension
install_curope_package: install the curope package by running pip install in the curope directory with CUDA support
configure_cuda_architectures: configure all available CUDA architectures dynamically using torch cuda get_gencode flags for compilation
compile_curope_with_optimizations: compile the curope extension with O3 optimization and fast math flags for nvcc and cxx compilers
setup_curope_build_extension: setup the curope build extension using setuptools with BuildExtension command class for torch CUDA support
